current_text_or_literal:
`BA-M6` was calculated from 54 stored state-by-site-by-day-type cell means and
their 54 by 54 covariance matrix without refitting the model. Its 27 contrast
vectors were applied once. Every point estimate was reconciled in two
independent ways: `BA-M4 - BA-M1`, and the Free-day `BA-M5` site deviation
minus the Work-day `BA-M5` site deviation. Within each state, the nine
deviations from the site-average effect summed to zero to machine tolerance.
approved_replacement:
The family of site-specific departures from the state-specific site-average
Free-minus-Work estimate (`BA-M6`) was calculated from 54 stored
state-by-site-by-day-type cell means and their 54 by 54 covariance matrix
without refitting the model. Its 27 contrast vectors were applied once. Every
point estimate was reconciled in two independent ways: the site-specific
Free-minus-Work difference against zero (`BA-M4`) minus the state-specific
site-average Free-minus-Work difference (`BA-M1`), and the Free-day site
deviation from the site-average adherence estimate (`BA-M5`) minus the
corresponding Work-day deviation (`BA-M5`). Within each state, the nine
deviations from the site-average effect summed to zero to machine tolerance.
preservation_contract: All 54 means, 54 by 54 covariance, 27 vectors, component identities, state sums, and no-refit boundary remain exact. Numeric-token multiset remains exact.
